title: Weather Campfire
description: Simple mod that adds a campfire and herbs that can change the weather
body:
So... I made a mod pack for 1.21.1 and after playing for a while I noticed that it was constantly raining in the game which became incredibly annoying. I think it wasn't like this in earlier versions of Minecraft or maybe it's just me. And that's basically why I made this mod.

The mod was made in [MCreator](https://mcreator.net/) because I don't know how to code so I don't know how well the code is optimized. It should be okay.

If you find any bugs report them on [GitHub](https://github.com/SromFunnyBoi/Weather-Campfire-Mod)(Remember I can't code and I did it in MCreator xpp)

And if you have any suggestions on how to improve it(Basically anything. Better textures, different mechanics, custom sounds etc.) you can send them [here.](https://freesuggestionbox.com/pub/qobtnis)

You can use this in modpacks.
(Tbh do whatever you want with it.)

The mod is very simple. It adds 1 block and 4 items.

## **Weather Campfire:**
